description: This PHP source file defines the 'NationalityAPI' class within the OrangeHRM system. It exposes REST API endpoints for managing nationalities, including CRUD operations such as retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting nationality records. The class utilizes various services, models, and validators provided by the OrangeHRM framework to process requests and enforce validation rules.

classes.name: NationalityAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing nationality entities. Implements CRUD operations—fetching individual nationalities, listing all, creating new entries, updating existing ones, and deleting multiple nationalities—validating input parameters and delivering responses in standardized formats.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific nationality by its ID, throws an exception if not found, and returns a resource result encapsulating the nationality data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all nationalities with support for sorting and pagination; returns a collection result containing the nationalities and total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new nationality record from request data and returns the created resource.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves or updates a nationality entity with provided 'name', returning the persisted entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing nationality identified by ID with new data, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more nationalities by provided IDs and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for 'getOne' operation, primarily validating 'id' as a positive integer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing nationalities, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a nationality, primarily ensuring 'name' is provided and within length constraints.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a nationality, including ensuring the 'name' is unique (excluding current record) and valid.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper function to generate validation rules for 'name', including string type, max length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deletion, validating list of IDs.
